★Request
Fade in

Trainer, thank you for keeping me company.
And also—
(WHOOSH!)
I had no idea, none at all... that this would happen...
Now then—launch!!

Yes, as reluctant as I am to leave...
Let us come sledding again.

Ever since then, I've been curious about the world she sees.
What kind of world is it that only she knows...?
The sky...? You're right... The sky is...!

A warmth welled up in my chest. The fact that we could enjoy the scenery of maximum speed together.
That made me unimaginably happy...!

Calstone Light O starts walking off on her own.
—Right then, a spark of inspiration hit me!

However, I will not give up.
I will reach that pinnacle of speed from that day on my own.

I landed squarely on my rear. Silently thanking the soft, thick grass,
I looked toward Calstone Light O—
Daddy, there's a hole in your pants.

Cold! Painful! Fast!!
So this is... maximum speed...!

Yes, for a short while. To feel the wind.
To explore the world of maximum speed.
We shall slide down in one go.
Your pants are torn at the rear.
Here we go! Returning once more to the world of maximum speed!

Oh, Trainer.
What a coincidence.

Well then, see you later.
I shall go search for a slope with a favorable angle.

How many times did we slide down after that?
Soaking in our journey through the sky, we both worked up a good sweat...!
I'm so glad... we could slide together!

It was truly a magnificent sight! In that case, I must go!
OHHHHHHHHHH!!

It has been quite a while since I felt this sensation.
Trainer, do not get thrown off.

Heh... You really do love going fast.
I'll join you as many times as you want today... *grunt*

! We! Through maximum speed!!
Are here right nowwwwwwwww!!!!
I shouted so much that a bug flew into my mouth!!!!

If we slide down together, I can actually keep up with her.
We should be able to see the scenery of maximum speed together.

Look at this incline.
If we lay cardboard here—

More, accelerate more! Who cares if the wind blows my hair off!!
Blow it right off!! UOOOOOOHHH--!!

Aaaahhh...!!
Haha, ahhahahaha! Unbelievable!!
I had no idea! Such speed! Such a view!!
What on earth happened? Pushing through my terror, I opened my eyes.

Calstone Light O was thrilled by the rushing scenery and wind pressure.
I was about to shut my eyes against the unfamiliar speed, but forced them open.

I will never forget when I first encountered this maximum speed.
It was one day back during my childhood—
Maximum speed—that word brings back memories of the other day.

Wait, the answer was right there in her story...!
A way to see the scenery of maximum speed—and together, no less!
With that, Calstone Light O's voice cut off.

Gh...!!!!
W-W-We're flyingggggg---!!?

I take a seat on Calstone Light O's cardboard sled.
I check my balance to make sure I don't fall off, and we're all set—!

Suddenly, I noticed a mound in the ground right in front of us.
At this rate, we're going to crash right into it...!

—We were in the sky. The cardboard sled bounced high into the air, flying.
High enough to see both ends of a rainbow...!

Eeeek~! It goes so whoosh with you, Daddy!
Again! Again!

Calstone Light O and I arrived at an obstacle course in the mountains.
She claims we can see the scenery of maximum speed here, but...

It is maximum speed because it is the fastest. That means no one can catch up.
Waiting here was a sound decision on your part.
(THUDDDDDD!!)

W-Whoa!
Fast! Overwhelmingly fast!!

—Ever since that day, my father began to hesitate
whenever it came to cardboard sledding.
YAAAAHOOOOOOOO!!

Haah, haah...! 
We sure did slide a lot...!

I see. Sledding with two people. Just like when I did with my father.
Doing so might make it go even more 'whoosh,' is that it?
...Well, that is more or less the gist of it.
Excuse me???
